newsitem.title: USA: Economist Bergsten advocates 100 yen to dlr level.
newsitem.headline: Economist Bergsten advocates 100 yen to dlr level.

text.p: The yen needed to get back close to the 100 to the dollar level in order to avoid a renewed jump in Japan's trade surplus and subsequent trade tensions, economist Fred Bergsten said Thursday.
"I happen to think the yen needs to get back close to the 100 to one level in order to avoid a renewed jump in the Japanese surplus," Bergsten said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.
Bergsten, director of the Institute for International Economics, said he thought the Japanese would like to see a stronger trade surplus to help get them out of their very weak economic performance.

"But I do think they do realize that carrying that too far would be extremely risky and in fact counterproductive because it would bring the rest of the world down on their necks and it would bring the markets to a point where the yen would sharply rise in value again...," he said.
